title: English Practice Quiz 0808
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 01: An executive summary should present:
options: The main issue, findings and recommended action
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: The main issue, findings and recommended action. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 02: A report heading should be:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Specific and informative. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 03: A recommendation should be supported by:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Relevant evidence and reasoning. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 04: Which sentence is objective?
options: The inspection identified three blocked exits.
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: The inspection identified three blocked exits.. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 05: Meeting minutes should record:
options: Decisions, actions, owners and due dates
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Decisions, actions, owners and due dates. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 06: A formal notice should clearly state:
options: What is changing, when it applies and who is affected
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: What is changing, when it applies and who is affected. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 07: A data table should include:
options: Clear headings and units where relevant
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Clear headings and units where relevant. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 08: Which phrase introduces a reason?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Due to the equipment failure. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 09: A corrective action report should identify:
options: The issue, cause, action owner and follow-up
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: The issue, cause, action owner and follow-up. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Business Writing and Reporting 10: Before submitting a report, check:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Facts, calculations and references. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.
